Package index

APA-style reporting

apa()
Format statistical results in APA style
apa_binom_mean_conf()
Format binomial proportions and confidence intervals in APA style
apa_ezStats()
Describe ezStats results
apa_format_mean_conf()
Format mean and confidence interval values into APA-style string
apa_mean_and_t()
Compare means with t-tests and format in APA style
apa_mean_conf()
Format means and confidence intervals in APA style
apa_mean_sd()
Format means and standard deviations in APA style
apa(<BFBayesFactor>)
Describe BayesFactor results
apa(<afex_aov>)
Describe afex ANOVA results
apa(<anova>)
Describe the results of ANOVA models or model comparisons
apa(<anova.merMod>)
Describe lmerTest anova results
apa(<aov>) apa(<aovlist>)
Describe stats::aov results
apa(<brmsfit>)
Describe brms model results
apa(<chisq.test>)
Format chi-square test results in APA style
apa(<dip.test>)
Describe Hartigans' dip test results
apa(<ezANOVA>)
Describe ezANOVA results
apa(<glm>) apa(<lm>) apa(<glmerMod>) apa(<lmerModLmerTest>)
Describe regression model (GLM, GLMer, lm, lm.circular, ...)
apa(<htest>)
Format t-test results in APA style
apa(<linearHypothesis>)
Describe linearHypothesis test results
apa(<list>)
Format results from list objects in APA style
apa(<r>)
Format correlation test results in APA style
apa(<roc.test>) apa(<roc.diff>)
Describe differences between ROC curves
apa(<summary.merMod>) apa(<lmert>)
Describe lmerTest results
apa(<summary_emm>) apa(<emmeans>)
Describe contrasts created by emmeans
apa(<ttest>)
Format t-test results in APA style
